Geometry_and_Silhouette: Portable rectangular slab, length 12-16 cm, width 6-8 cm, thickness 1-2 cm.
Screen is LCD or touchscreen (3-5 inches) occupying most of front face.
Below screen: physical QWERTY keyboard (miniature keys) or navigation pad with directional buttons.
Functional_Components: Ports on edges: USB, headphone jack, charging port.
Stylus may slot into side.
Screen displays operating system interface with icons and text.
Material_and_Context: Casing is plastic (black, silver, or colored) with smooth matte finish.
Weight is 100-200 grams.
Battery-powered computer small enough for pocket carriage.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Square piece of cloth, 30x30 cm to 50x50 cm.
Edges are hemmed (narrow rolled hem) or hand-rolled (silk).
When folded, forms compact rectangle.
Functional_Components: Surface may be plain white, printed with patterns (paisley, floral, geometric), or embroidered with monogram.
Fabric weight is light to medium, draping softly when held.
Texture is smooth (cotton/silk) or slightly textured (linen).
Material_and_Context: Material is cotton (white, smooth weave), linen (textured, natural), or silk (lustrous, smooth).
Color varies: white, cream, pastel, or bold prints.
Square cloth for personal use.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Rigid rectangular enclosure, 3.5-inch desktop (14.7x10.2x2.6 cm) or 2.5-inch laptop (10x7x0.7 cm).
Enclosure is aluminum or steel (silver, brushed finish).
Connector edge shows SATA or IDE interface (gold-plated pins).
Functional_Components: Label showing capacity, model, and specifications.
Surface is smooth metal with mounting screw holes.
Label includes barcode, serial number, and regulatory markings.
Material_and_Context: Sealed metal enclosure for magnetic storage.
Internal components (visible if opened): circular platters (mirror-like reflective surface), actuator arm with read/write head.
Aluminum or steel construction with brushed finish.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Small rectangular wind instrument, 10-12 cm long, 3-4 cm wide, 1.5-2 cm thick.
Body consists of metal cover plates sandwiching wooden or plastic comb.
Cover plates are curved or flat with embossed brand logo.
Functional_Components: Comb has 10 holes (diatonic) or more (chromatic) for blowing/drawing.
Chromatic variant shows slide button on side.
Hole openings are rectangular slots on playing edge.
Material_and_Context: Metal cover plates (chrome, brass, or stainless steel) with polished reflective finish.
Engraving on cover plates shows maker's mark and model.
Weight is 80-120 grams.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Triangular-framed stringed instrument, height 150-190 cm (concert grand).
Pillar is straight column (wood or metal) supporting structure.
Neck is curved arm with tuning pins along top edge.
Functional_Components: Strings (47 for concert harp) run vertically from neck pins to soundboard, varying in thickness and color.
Pedals (7) at base adjust pitch.
Soundboard is wooden (spruce) with arched surface and sound holes.
Material_and_Context: Wood finish is polished (natural grain visible) or painted.
Gold leaf accents on decorative elements.
Strings are gut, nylon, or wire.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Large self-propelled vehicle, length 8-12 m, height 3.5-4 m.
Front-mounted header (cutting platform, 4-12 m wide).
Cab is elevated with large windows for visibility.
Functional_Components: Header has rotating reel with tines and cutter bar.
Body has boxy grain tank on top with unloading auger (folded pipe extending sideways).
Rear shows straw chopper and chaff spreader.
Material_and_Context: Color is brand-specific (John Deere green, Case IH red, New Holland blue).
Wheels are large (front) and smaller (rear) with deep tread tires.
Agricultural machine for crop gathering.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Small single-handed axe, total length 25-35 cm.
Head is forged steel with sharp cutting edge (bevel angle 25-30 degrees).
Overall compact form for one-handed use.
Functional_Components: Eye (hole) accepts wooden handle with wedge securing.
Cutting edge shows honed bevel.
Some variants include hammer poll or nail-pulling notch.
Material_and_Context: Head is forged steel (polished or painted black).
Handle is smooth wood (hickory) with visible grain, or fiberglass/rubber grip.
Head weight 400-700 grams. Surface texture: smooth metal head, grippy handle.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Sheath conforming to pistol outline.
Dimensions match handgun size.
Belt loop or paddle attachment on back for waist carry.
Functional_Components: Retention strap or friction fit.
Retention mechanism: thumb break strap, passive friction, or adjustable screw.
Interior is smooth to allow quick draw.
Material_and_Context: Leather (brown, black, or tan) or synthetic (nylon, Kydex).
Construction shows stitched seams (leather) or molded form (Kydex, smooth rigid surface).
Exterior may show tooling patterns (western-style) or plain finish.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Integrated entertainment setup with large-screen display (55-85 inches), thin bezel.
Display is wall-mounted or on stand.
Speakers are bookshelf or floor-standing with fabric grilles.
Functional_Components: Surround sound speaker array (front left/right, center, rear surrounds, subwoofer).
Subwoofer is box-shaped (front-firing or down-firing).
Receiver is rack-mounted unit with display and controls.
Material_and_Context: Room features acoustic treatment, dim lighting, and tiered seating.
Cable management conceals connections.
Components: flat-panel TV or projector with screen, media player/receiver.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Hexagonal cell framework pattern.
Cell shape is regular hexagon with uniform wall thickness.
Pattern is tessellated hexagonal grid with consistent cell size.
Functional_Components: Paper variant: accordion-folded strips expanded into 3D honeycomb, lightweight, colorful.
Metal variant: thin foil walls forming hexagonal grid, visible in cross-section.
Natural wax: cells filled with honey (amber liquid) or capped with white wax.
Material_and_Context: Paper (expanded honeycomb decorations), aluminum (aerospace honeycomb core), plastic, or wax (natural beeswax, golden-yellow).
Natural wax: golden-brown color with slight translucency.
Material varies by application: decorative, aerospace, or natural.
